field_of_expertise.detail: Aerospace engineer serving as both Crew Commander and Crew Engineer for the FMARS leg

source_citation: SRC-mars160-fmars-crew-arrival, SpaceFlight Insider, 'Mars 160: 6-person crew arrives at Arctic station', July 2017 (FMARS-leg crew arrival at Flashline Station, Devon Island): commander described as a French aerospace engineer serving as both Crew Commander and Crew Engineer for the mission. Role and nationality independently corroborated by Mars Society mission materials (mars160.marssociety.org/meet-the-crew/). No explicit gender pronoun found in the material reviewed; gender recorded as undisclosed.
